holdout.note: Sign agreement between in-sample and held-out estimates. 'powered' restricts to pairs clearing the episode floor on both sides of the split; 'raw' includes every pair and is dominated by pairs with too few test episodes to carry a meaningful sign. Diagnostic only; does not gate edge publication.

placebo.note: Placebo re-runs the full pipeline with shock dates randomised. The observed edge count must sit clearly above the placebo distribution; PASS means chance reproduced it in <=5% of runs.
